note: John's traces for tools/andromache.py, each drawn over a crop of the plate (FR I Taf. 34, Heidelberg scan) enlarged 3x, registered back onto the plate by SIFT. Plate px. lines: his strokes as polylines along their centres; solids: the marks he filled in, as polygons; dots: the small round marks he made, as points; fill: the areas he marked to be filled (the blood), painted over a screenshot of the drawing and placed by its ruler; fill_dark, fill_light: the same, painted on his crop in two greens, the darker blood and the lighter; pen: the width of his strokes; box: the crop he traced.
